document.abstract: This standard specifies the mapping of ISO/IEC 13818-7 and ISO/IEC 14496-3 AAC family compressed audio coding into the Material Exchange Format Generic Container (MXF-GC). It does not address mapping of uncompressed audio or audio compressed with other codecs.
